tools.name: portrait_health
tools.purpose: Return adapter and ComfyUI health, versions, queue state, and profile.

tools.name: portrait_capabilities
tools.purpose: Return detected routes, node classes, model loaders, MPS or CUDA capability, and known limits.

tools.name: portrait_inventory
tools.purpose: Return custom-node and model inventory with missing dependency findings.

tools.name: portrait_validate_workflow
tools.purpose: Validate a named workflow against node classes, models, graph policy, and profile.

tools.name: portrait_import_workflow
tools.purpose: Register a checksummed workflow artifact after validation.

tools.name: portrait_upload_source
tools.purpose: Create an authenticated, checksummed source upload inside one job root.

tools.name: portrait_submit_job
tools.purpose: Validate the input schema and enqueue a portrait job idempotently.

tools.name: portrait_job_status
tools.purpose: Return structured state, progress, active stage, warnings, and blockers.

tools.name: portrait_watch_job
tools.purpose: Stream or long-poll structured progress without exposing raw ComfyUI.

tools.name: portrait_cancel_job
tools.purpose: Cancel a queued or active job and preserve cancellation evidence.

tools.name: portrait_fetch_outputs
tools.purpose: Return authorized output descriptors and checksums after job completion.

tools.name: portrait_history
tools.purpose: Return bounded job history and audit references.

tools.name: portrait_free_memory
tools.purpose: Request verified ComfyUI model unloading and report memory state.

warning: These are planned project-owned tool names. They are not claimed to exist in ComfyUI or another MCP server.
